pages.title: Chapter 5: Advanced Crafting
pages.text: §7[Continue from Copper Slot]$(br2)After mastering the basic cold forging, you can make more complex products. Starting from copper slot, you can craft various items.

pages.title: Making Rings and Hooks
pages.text: From copper slot, use axe right-click to craft rings, hooks and pins:$(br2)$(li)Copper Slot + Axe Right-click → §4Copper Ring$(br)$(li)Copper Ring + Axe Right-click → §4Copper Hook$(br)$(li)Copper Hook + Axe Right-click → §4Copper Pin$(br2)Silver and gold slots convert directly to their respective pins - there are no intermediate ring or hook steps.
§cCopper Ring - Processed from copper slot, used for rings and fishing rods.
§cCopper Hook - Processed from copper ring, used for hanging or decoration.

pages.title: §7[Final Products You Can Make]
pages.text: $(li)§cWeapons: Primitive copper knife, wrought copper sword (needs assembly)$(br)$(li)§cTools: Wrought copper axe (forged from curve)$(br)$(li)§cArmor: Pin chestplate (decorative)$(br)$(li)§cAccessories: Rings, hooks, beads, bars and more$(br)$(li)§cFunctional: Copper fishing rod and more
§aCopper Fishing Rod - Copper Ring + Copper Hook + String + Stick. Craft the ring and hook first, then assemble at the crafting table.

pages.title: Product Values
pages.text: Different metal products have different values:$(br)$(li)Copper - Basic equipment, practical and reliable$(br)$(li)Silver - Excellent performance, strong decorative value$(br)$(li)Gold - Extremely precious, premium decoration$(br2)Additionally, pin chestplates can be worn as chest accessories.
